League of Legends is developed and published by Riot Games and released in October 2009.

Club Penguin's Town, with the Coffee Shop, Dance Club and Clothes Shop. The game ran from 2005 to 2017.
Which online game is this screenshot from?
RuneScape, developed by Jagex and first released on 4 January 2001 as a browser game.
Which company bought Club Penguin in 2007?
The Walt Disney Company bought New Horizon, Club Penguin's maker, in August 2007 for 350 million dollars.
Which company bought Vine four months after it was founded?
Twitter bought Vine for 30 million dollars in 2012, before its January 2013 launch.

In the car after oral surgery, David asked "Is this real life?" and "Is this going to be forever?"

League of Legends has been released since October 2009.

Rick Astley and "Never Gonna Give You Up" (1987), the video behind Rickrolling.

Newgrounds, founded by Tom Fulp in 1995, hosts user-made games and movies.

Miniclip launched on 30 March 2001, founded by Robert Small and Tihan Presbie.

Jeff Kinney, later author of Diary of a Wimpy Kid, was the main creator of Poptropica (2007).

Kyle Craven's yearbook photo was posted on Reddit in 2012 and became an image macro.

Jason Steele made both through FilmCow: Charlie the Unicorn (2005) and Llamas with Hats (2009).

The public alpha started on 17 May 2009; the full release followed on 18 November 2011.
What kind of game is Audition Online?
Audition Online, from T3 Entertainment, is a free-to-play multiplayer rhythm game released in South Korea in 2004.
Epic Meal Time is a cooking show from which country?
Epic Meal Time debuted in October 2010 and is hosted by Montreal's Harley Morenstein.

Ninja Kiwi began Bloons Tower Defense as a browser game in mid 2007.

"Revenge" (2011) parodies Usher's "DJ Got Us Fallin' in Love".

Tim Chantarangsu was a Wild 'N Out cast member from 2013 to 2018 and 2020 to 2021.

Line Rider's Boštjan Čadež was a student from which country?
Boštjan Čadež, a Slovenian student, created Line Rider in September 2006.

Wesley Chan, Ted Fu and Philip Wang met at UC San Diego in 2004.
D-Trix is a member of which dance crew?
Dominic Sandoval, D-Trix, is a member of Quest Crew.
Which comedian's "Shoes" video as Kelly was one of YouTube's first viral hits?
